Name: Bedroom and Kitchenette for Willy and Rasmodius
Author: 7Kana
Description:
[color=#ffff00][size=5]My mods are only here on Nexus, please don't post my work elsewhere![/size][/color]

Bedroom and kitchenette for Willy and Rasmodius.I made two versions CP and xnb (on request), Willy's room is different in the versions for obvious reasons, with CP I could create the room upstairs while in xnb I couldn't.
But at night they won't go to sleep, it's just for aesthetics.
Aquarium in Willy's room is animated.

[CP] Version Intallation: After unzipping it should be placed in the Mods folder of Stardew Valley.

xnb Version no need SMAPI and Content Patcher
Installation:
Make a backup of the original files and then copy these to:
For GOG Games
C (or disk where the game is installed):/GOG Games/Stardew Valley/Content/Maps
For Steam
C (or disk where the game is installed):/SteamLibrary/steamMaps/common/Stardew Valley/Content/Maps

Enjoy!

Maybe you might be interested in my other [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/181358142?tab=user+files]Mods[/url]

If you appreciate my work could you buy me a coffee [url=https://ko-fi.com/kanacane]Ko fi[/url] ?
